collection.eligibleSourceCountDefinition: Original projectRecordsWithEligibleSaleRows/RentRows count all registered native asset types. Direct subject counters exclude Land/Building; native monthly/quarterly and subtype aggregates overlap.

collection.collectionCompleteness: Bounded primary research pass; exhaustive historical coverage is not claimed

collection.method: Bounded manual review of five primary pages; extracted factual dates only, no source body or imagery stored or redistributed.
Reviewed concise dated facts from primary developer releases; raw copyrighted bodies not reproduced.

sourceEnrichment.methodology: Primary registers and attributable public fact extraction. Exact identity gates precede subject links. Current-vintage historical inputs are unavailable at earlier forecast origins. Fetch coverage, lifecycle coverage and observed financial coverage remain separate. Raw pages and primary individual registers remain private.

coverage.note: Three selected CBUAE policy decisions supplement the existing tightening/easing chronology. Intervening decisions and subsequent rates have not been enumerated.

limits: The CBUAE Base Rate is anchored to the US Federal Reserve's Interest on Reserve Balances; it is not the federal-funds target range.
The Base Rate is an overnight money-market policy rate, not a retail mortgage quote, EIBOR tenor, lender margin or borrower-specific financing cost.
These selected observations cannot be forward-filled into a complete policy-rate history without enumerating intervening and subsequent decisions.
Rate changes are financing context; no local price response, investment return, migration effect or causal coefficient is inferred.
